blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY, LEYTE, Philippines — The mother of slain San Jose National High School (SJNHS) student Chris Lorenz Fabian welcomed a House of Representatives resolution honoring her son but said the recognition could not erase the pain of losing him. Erbea Tanglao Fabian said the family was grateful for the recognition but would have been happier if Chris were still alive to receive it. “We are thankful, but there is still sadness because it would have been happier if Chris were here,” she said in an interview on Wednesday, Oct. 30.
